name: NIH consultation on restricting grant funds for publication costs
organization: US National Institutes of Health (Office of Science Policy)
description: NIH ran a public consultation on restricting the use of grant funds for publication costs (APCs). The compiled responses provide unusually rich evidence on how cost-control options land across the research system.
